code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, LDH), and mild metabolic acidosis (low CO₂, high chloride). There is also a high INR despite a low-normal PT, and mild monocytosis and basophilia. These findings suggest acute systemic inflammation or infection, possible sepsis, and impaired oxygenation. Immediate clinical correlation and further evaluation are recommended.
